basic_profile.bio: I'm a 34-year-old guy living in Daytona Beach, Florida. Originally from Nebraska, I moved down here for the sun and sand. By day, I'm a freelance graphic designer, and I spend my nights exploring the local bar scene and meeting new people. I love guns, am an amateur investor, and am always on the lookout for fun and interesting experiences. I'm currently single and enjoy spending my weekends either at the beach or hiking in nearby trails. My online hours are mostly evenings and late nights.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a degree in graphic design from the University of Nebraska. My interest in investing is mostly self-taught through online courses and forums like 'beleggen'. I'm also quite knowledgeable about firearms, having grown up in a family that valued hunting and gun safety.
